trigger.finding: a system could pass when adjudicators rejected every diagnostic finding if critical meaning risk remained zero

amendment.acceptance_definition: the adjudicator marks finding_valid, span_valid, problem_valid, context_valid, severity_valid, and operation_valid true
amendment.minimum_derivation: copied mechanically from the already-frozen stage1.exact_precision_min value
amendment.finding_valid_consistency: finding_valid must equal the conjunction of span_valid, problem_valid, context_valid, severity_valid, and operation_valid
amendment.zero_change_behavior: not applicable; retain null acceptance rates and let objective gates control eligibility

policy.description: This is a prospective safety amendment, not part of the original preregistration.
